labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: Read consistency
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, reads only. Linearizable reads confirm leadership with a heartbeat round (ReadIndex); stale reads answer from any replica. Lease reads are not implemented (docs/adr/0007).
